unified_features.name: Contacts
unified_features.rationale: Only MegaCRM has contacts; DealFlow has none, so nothing to merge.
unified_features.behaviour: Create, edit and list contacts (name required, email unique, optional company); search by a substring of name or email.
unified_features.improvements: Search wraps the text in wildcards explicitly instead of relying on the caller; email uniqueness is case-insensitive.

unified_features.name: Contact merge
unified_features.rationale: Only MegaCRM merges duplicates; kept as its own feature because it has a different job from contact editing.
unified_features.behaviour: Merge a dropped contact into a kept one in one transaction: reassign its deals, fill the kept contact's empty fields from the dropped one, delete the dropped contact, and record the merge in an audit entry.
unified_features.improvements: Transactional; reassigns every child record; no data from the dropped contact is silently lost; audit entry.

unified_features.name: Deals pipeline
unified_features.rationale: Both apps move deals through stages; A has the richer deal record and a stage set with separate won and lost outcomes, B has configurable stages and records when a deal last moved. One pipeline combines both instead of keeping two.
unified_features.behaviour: Deals belong to a contact and an owner and have a title and value in cents. Stages are configurable data (name, position, closed outcome won/lost/none), seeded with lead, qualified, proposal, won, lost. Moving a deal to a stage that is not configured is rejected; every move sets moved_at.
unified_features.improvements: Stages stored as data with an explicit closed outcome so reminders can skip closed deals; moved_at stored as timezone-aware UTC.

unified_features.name: CSV export
unified_features.rationale: Only MegaCRM exports; kept as its own reporting feature.
unified_features.behaviour: Download contacts or deals as CSV with a header row; deals include stage, moved_at and owner.
unified_features.improvements: Header row; only the named exports (contacts, deals) are accepted, never a caller-supplied table name.

unified_features.name: Stale-deal reminders
unified_features.rationale: Only DealFlow has reminders; kept as its own notification feature built on the unified pipeline's moved_at.
unified_features.behaviour: A scheduled job emails each open deal's owner once when the deal has not moved for the configured number of days (default 14).
unified_features.improvements: Skips deals in closed stages; at most one reminder per deal per idle period (dedupe on deal id and moved_at); threshold is a setting; owner comes from the deal's owner user, not a free-text email.
